literal: many - those things - even having learned - benefit - they are without indeed - good - assembly-in - well - to reach - those who do not speak
translation: Those who cannot speak well and convincingly in a good assembly derive no benefit at all, even if they have learned many things.
modern: நல்ல அறிஞர்கள் நிறைந்த அவையில், அவர்கள் மனம் ஏற்குமாறு நன்றாகப் பேச முடியாதவர்கள், பல நூல்களைக் கற்றிருந்தாலும் அதனால் ஒரு பயனும் இல்லாதவர்களே ஆவர்.
explanation: This couplet highlights that mere accumulation of knowledge is useless if one cannot communicate it effectively. The word 'அவை' appears twice with different meanings: first as 'those things' (referring to subjects of study) and then as 'assembly'. The phrase 'நன்கு செல' (to go well) vividly captures the idea of words reaching and penetrating the minds of the audience. Even if a person has learned many subjects, their learning yields no benefit ('பயமிலரே') if they lack the courage and skill to articulate it clearly in a gathering of good scholars.
